issue.title: Add JDK21 sequenced collections for ReturnsEmptyValues
issue.body:
JDK 21 introduced [Sequenced Collections (JEP 431)](https://openjdk.org/jeps/431) which added new interfaces to the `java.util` Collections API. Using these interfaces as return types leads to Mockito returning `null` when the method is unstubbed since they are obviously missing in `org.mockito.internal.stubbing.defaultanswers.ReturnsEmptyValues`.

Is it possible to add this new API or impossible because of Java 11 baseline?
